Classification: review-confirmed defect.

Source task: 01a09c57-2ac2-7981-8f33-21ede2d89ca2

3. **P1 — Public provider responses expose raw error reasons.**  
   [provider_response.ex:115](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/contracts/provider_response.ex:115) copies `response.reason` without sanitization. The field accepts any term, including a Req error reason such as `{:invalid_header_value, "authorization", value}`. The public map and custom `Inspect` expose that value. The tuple also makes JSON encoding fail. Both effects were reproduced.  
   **Correction:** Normalize transport reasons to stable codes. Put only sanitized diagnostic data in a separate field. Apply the same rules to the public map and `Inspect`.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
title: Public provider responses expose raw error reasons
